entries.name: ad-copywriter
entries.description: Use for paid ad copy — Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads (search and display), LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube ads. Produces multiple variants per ad set, not creative direction.

entries.name: all-hands-talking-points-writer
entries.description: Use for all-hands meeting talking points, prepared remarks, monthly company-update scripts. Produces what the leader actually says, not the slide deck (use demo-deck-writer for slides).

entries.name: api-doc-writer
entries.description: Use for API and SDK documentation — endpoint references, getting-started guides, authentication docs, error-code tables, webhook docs, SDK quickstarts. Developer-audience. Pair with release-notes-writer for API change announcements.

entries.name: battlecard-writer
entries.description: Use for sales battlecards — competitor-by-competitor or category cards that arm reps in live deals. Produces field-ready cards, not market analyses (use competitive-analyst for analysis).

entries.name: blog-post-writer
entries.description: Use for long-form blog posts — guides, tutorials, opinion pieces, comparison posts, listicles, case studies. Produces full drafts with H2/H3 structure. Use seo-meta-writer separately for meta tags.

entries.name: board-financial-update-writer
entries.description: Use for the financial section of board updates — KPI dashboards, MoM/QoQ/YoY narratives, P&L commentary, runway updates, plan-vs-actual writeups. Produces the financial-section copy and structure. Pair with board-update-writer for the full update.

entries.name: board-update-writer
entries.description: Use for board updates, monthly investor updates, board pre-reads. Produces the prose update; pair with board-financial-update-writer for the financials section.

entries.name: book-outline-writer
entries.description: Use for book outlines — non-fiction business books, memoirs, narrative non-fiction, technical books, how-to / craft books. Produces the chapter-level outline; pair with blog-post-writer for individual chapters at draft time.

entries.name: brand-voice-coach
entries.description: Use for brand-voice work — voice and tone guidelines, voice audits, voice transitions (post-rebrand, post-leadership-change), copy-review feedback, voice training for new writers. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: budget-narrative-writer
entries.description: Use for budget narratives — the prose that accompanies a budget submission, plan, or reforecast. Explains the "why" behind the numbers. Produces the narrative; pair with fp-and-a-strategist for the underlying model.

entries.name: case-study-writer
entries.description: Use for customer case studies — written for use in sales decks, landing pages, blog, and proposals. Produces the case study artifact; pair with landing-page-copywriter for the page surrounding it.

entries.name: ceo-advisor
entries.description: Use when the user wants to think through a CEO-level decision — strategy, fundraising, board management, exec hiring, board composition, M&A, pivot/persevere calls, leadership transitions. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: cfo-advisor
entries.description: Use for CFO-level decisions — fundraising strategy, runway management, plan design, hiring authorizations, M&A finance, equity strategy, audit/compliance posture, IPO readiness. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: chief-of-staff-advisor
entries.description: Use for chief-of-staff thinking — exec-team facilitation, strategic-priority management, OKR-process design, decision throughput, exec calendar architecture, special-project leadership. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: churn-save-script-writer
entries.description: Use for churn-save scripts — the conversation script a CSM or success leader uses when a customer signals they're leaving. Produces the script and supporting comms. Pair with cs-leader-advisor for upstream save strategy.

entries.name: cmo-advisor
entries.description: Use when the user wants to think through a marketing strategy decision — channel mix, brand positioning, org structure, marketing OKRs, budget allocation, fractional-CMO-style strategic questions. Not for producing artifacts (use the artifact specialists for that).

entries.name: cold-outreach-copywriter
entries.description: Use for cold outreach — cold email prospecting, cold LinkedIn DMs, partnership intros, link-building emails. For first-touch only; use sales-email-writer for follow-ups inside an existing sequence.

entries.name: company-values-writer
entries.description: Use for drafting or rewriting company values, operating principles, "how we work" docs, leadership principles. Produces the values document. Pair with people-policy-writer for downstream policies.

entries.name: compensation-strategist
entries.description: Use for comp design — leveling rubrics, banding, equity refresh strategy, sales comp, exec comp, geo-pay, comp philosophy. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: competitive-analyst
entries.description: Use for competitive research and analysis — competitor teardowns, feature comparisons, pricing-page audits, messaging audits, market-map building, win/loss synthesis. Produces analysis, not artifacts.

entries.name: content-strategist
entries.description: Use when the user wants to plan content — content calendars, pillar/cluster strategies, distribution plans, repurposing playbooks, editorial themes, brand voice guidelines. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: coo-advisor
entries.description: Use when the user wants COO-level thinking — operating cadence, exec team coordination, cross-functional execution, scaling org structure, removing organizational friction. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: course-curriculum-writer
entries.description: Use for course curriculum design — online courses, cohort-based courses, internal training, university/bootcamp curricula. Produces the learning-objective-driven curriculum; pair with video-script-writer for lesson scripts.

entries.name: creative-director-advisor
entries.description: Use for creative-direction questions — campaign direction, design-system strategy, brand-system rebuilds, creative-team operating-model, when to hire a CD vs. an agency. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: crisis-comms-coach
entries.description: Use for crisis and sensitive communications — outages, security incidents, layoffs, leadership departures, public missteps, customer-data issues. Coaches the leader on what to say and how. Pair with exec-comms-writer to produce the message.

entries.name: cs-leader-advisor
entries.description: Use for VP CS / Chief Customer Officer decisions — CS org design, comp design for CSMs, segmentation, retention strategy, expansion strategy, churn investigation, renewal forecasting. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: csm-coach
entries.description: Use for one-on-one CSM coaching — call audits, customer-conversation prep, escalation prep, executive-conversation prep, expansion conversation prep. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: customer-apology-writer
entries.description: Use for customer apologies and recovery comms — apologies for outages, billing errors, missed SLAs, support-quality failures, miscommunication, account-team mistakes. Produces the customer-facing message. Pair with crisis-comms-coach for upstream framing.

entries.name: customer-health-summary-writer
entries.description: Use for customer health summaries — the structured writeups CSMs and CS leaders use for renewal forecasting, exec-team reviews, and at-risk-account triage. Produces the analysis, not the customer-facing artifact (use qbr-deck-writer for that).

entries.name: decision-memo-writer
entries.description: Use for decision memos — structured docs for making and recording decisions (the kind written before a decision is taken, not after). Produces a decision-doc artifact in Amazon-six-pager / RFC / "decision record" style.

entries.name: demo-deck-writer
entries.description: Use for demo decks and demo scripts — slide-by-slide copy and the talk track that goes with it. For sales demos, customer-onboarding demos, partner demos. Produces the deck content, not the visual design.

entries.name: discovery-call-script-writer
entries.description: Use for sales discovery call scripts — structured agendas, qualifying questions, problem-framing, demo tee-ups, and next-step language. Produces the script, not the strategy.

entries.name: discovery-coach
entries.description: Use when the user wants to improve their (or their team's) sales discovery — call audits, question design, qualification frameworks, MEDDIC/SPIN/BANT pressure-testing, follow-up coaching. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: employee-experience-coach
entries.description: Use for employee-experience and culture work — engagement surveys, internal-comms strategy, ritual design (off-sites, all-hands cadence, recognition), retention-driver analysis, manager-development design. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: engineering-leader-advisor
entries.description: Use for VP Engineering / CTO decisions — engineering org design, build-vs-buy, technical debt strategy, hiring strategy for eng, technical-leadership calls, on-call/reliability investment. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: enterprise-sales-coach
entries.description: Use for complex enterprise deals — multi-stakeholder deals, RFP responses, procurement navigation, security-review wrangling, executive sponsor strategy. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: exec-coach
entries.description: Use for one-on-one executive coaching — career inflection points, leadership style, hard conversations, founder/CEO struggles, peer-relationship issues, team dynamics, imposter moments. Listening-first, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: exec-comms-writer
entries.description: Use for short executive communications — Slack announcements, all-hands one-pagers, internal email blasts, leadership email replies, exec social posts. Short-form, voice-of-the-leader. For long-form vision pieces use vision-memo-writer.

entries.name: expansion-pitch-writer
entries.description: Use for expansion / upsell / cross-sell pitches — the conversation script and supporting collateral when a CSM or AE expands an existing account. Produces the pitch artifact; pair with proposal-writer if formal documentation follows.

entries.name: financial-policy-writer
entries.description: Use for finance policies — expense policy, T&E, procurement, signing authority, capex approvals, vendor contract policy, revenue recognition, AR/AP cycle policy. Produces the policy artifact, not legal review.

entries.name: fp-and-a-strategist
entries.description: Use for FP&A work — financial modeling, plan design, scenario analysis, forecasting methodology, dashboard design, finance-data architecture. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: fundraise-narrative-coach
entries.description: Use for shaping fundraise narrative and pitch — the story arc, the why-now, the wedge, the moat, the trajectory framing, the "ask" framing. Strategic, not artifact-producing — pair with vision-memo-writer or demo-deck-writer for actual artifacts.

entries.name: growth-strategist
entries.description: Use when the user wants to design or audit a growth strategy — funnels, channels, growth loops, activation/retention/referral mechanics, north-star metrics, growth experiments. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: interview-kit-builder
entries.description: Use for interview kits — the full set of interviews, questions, rubrics, and debrief forms for a specific role. Produces the kit; pair with job-description-writer for the JD itself.

entries.name: investor-update-writer
entries.description: Use for monthly or quarterly investor updates — short, narrative-style updates sent to existing investors and angels. Lighter and warmer than board updates. Produces the email/memo.

entries.name: job-description-writer
entries.description: Use for job descriptions and role specs — full external JDs, internal role specs, leveling rubrics, hiring scorecards. Produces the JD; pair with interview-kit-builder for downstream interview design.

entries.name: landing-page-copywriter
entries.description: Use for landing page copy — full pages or specific sections (hero, features, social proof, FAQ, pricing, footer CTA). Produces copy with section structure, not visual design.

entries.name: migration-plan-writer
entries.description: Use for migration plans — database migrations, infrastructure migrations, vendor migrations, framework upgrades, monolith decompositions. Produces the structured plan, not the change-management comms (use exec-comms-writer for that).

entries.name: mutual-action-plan-writer
entries.description: Use for mutual action plans (MAPs) — joint deal-progression docs the rep and the buyer co-own through procurement. For mid-to-large complex deals. Produces the MAP, not the deal strategy (use sales-leader-advisor for that).

entries.name: newsletter-writer
entries.description: Use for newsletter editions — weekly roundups, founder updates, lifecycle newsletters, customer-facing product updates. Produces full editions, not subscription-funnel copy.

entries.name: objection-handling-playbook-writer
entries.description: Use for objection-handling playbooks — full sets of objection cards reps reference in live conversations. Produces the playbook artifact; for live in-call coaching see sales-leader-advisor.

entries.name: offer-letter-writer
entries.description: Use for offer letters and offer summaries — formal letters, candidate-facing summaries of comp packages, equity explainers, decline-graceful language. Produces the letter, not the comp strategy (use compensation-strategist for that).

entries.name: okr-writer
entries.description: Use for OKRs — company, function, team, or individual OKRs. Produces well-formed objectives and measurable key results, plus alignment notes. Pair with chief-of-staff-advisor for the upstream OKR strategy.

entries.name: onboarding-plan-writer
entries.description: Use for onboarding plans — week-by-week plans for new hires (engineers, AEs, execs). Produces structured 30/60/90 plans with milestones, intros, reading lists, and first-output expectations.

entries.name: operating-cadence-writer
entries.description: Use for operating-cadence design — the doc that describes how the company runs (weekly leadership, MBR, QBR, planning cycles). Produces the cadence document. Pair with coo-advisor for the strategy behind the cadence.

entries.name: operations-strategist
entries.description: Use for ops strategy — operating-model design, process strategy, cross-functional bottleneck analysis, automation/tooling strategy, organizational throughput diagnostics. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: org-design-strategist
entries.description: Use for organizational design — reporting lines, team structure, span-of-control, where to centralize vs. decentralize, when to introduce a new exec layer, when to merge functions. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: people-leader-advisor
entries.description: Use for VP People / CHRO / Head of People decisions — performance issues, leveling/calibration disputes, culture problems, retention, engagement, exec hires, organizational issues. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: people-policy-writer
entries.description: Use for people-policy documents — handbooks, code-of-conduct, remote-work policies, time-off, expense, parental leave, performance, leveling rubrics. Produces the policy artifact, not legal review.

entries.name: perf-review-writer
entries.description: Use for performance review writing — manager-side reviews of direct reports, self-reviews, peer feedback, calibration write-ups, growth plans, performance-improvement plans. Produces the written artifact.

entries.name: pipeline-strategist
entries.description: Use for pipeline analysis and strategy — pipeline reviews, coverage analysis, conversion-rate diagnostics, stage redesign, forecast pressure-testing, gen-targets math. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: podcast-show-notes-writer
entries.description: Use for podcast show notes — episode summaries, time-stamped segments, guest bios, key takeaways, social pull-quotes, related links. Produces show-notes pages and accompanying social copy.

entries.name: positioning-coach
entries.description: Use when the user wants to nail positioning, messaging, ICP, value props, category, or competitive differentiation. Often the upstream problem when content "isn't landing." Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: postmortem-writer
entries.description: Use for postmortems — incident postmortems (outages, security incidents), launch postmortems, deal-loss postmortems, project postmortems. Produces blameless, action-driven writeups.

entries.name: prd-writer
entries.description: Use for product requirements docs (PRDs) — feature specs, product specs, "what we're building and why" docs for engineering and design teams. Forward-looking. Pair with decision-memo-writer when a *decision* is the artifact, not a *spec*.

entries.name: press-release-writer
entries.description: Use for press releases — funding announcements, product launches, partnerships, hires, milestones. Produces a wire-ready release plus a journalist-friendly pitch email. Not for blog announcements (use blog-post-writer).

entries.name: prioritization-coach
entries.description: Use for prioritization conversations — RICE / WSJF / impact-effort / opportunity-sizing exercises, backlog grooming, "what should we work on next" decisions, sprint-planning trade-offs. Operational, not strategic — for strategic prioritization use strategy-coach.

entries.name: process-doc-writer
entries.description: Use for process documentation — runbooks, playbooks, SOPs, "how we do X" docs. For internal-team use, not customer-facing docs. Produces docs people actually follow, not docs that exist for compliance only.

entries.name: product-leader-advisor
entries.description: Use for VP Product / CPO decisions — roadmap design, portfolio prioritization, PM hiring, product-org structure, OKR alignment, product-quality calls, product-strategy bets. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: product-strategist
entries.description: Use for product strategy — multi-quarter roadmap design, portfolio bets, market-entry products, differentiation strategy, product-led-growth strategy, expansion-product evaluation. Strategic, not artifact-producing — pair with prd-writer for the spec once strategy is clear.

entries.name: proposal-writer
entries.description: Use for sales proposals — cover letters, executive summaries, scope-of-work language, pricing presentation, and terms placeholders. For closing-stage deals, not early discovery. Produces the proposal copy, not the contract redlines.

entries.name: qbr-deck-writer
entries.description: Use for Quarterly Business Reviews — the deck a CSM brings to a customer's exec sponsor to recap value delivered, surface adoption risks, and tee up next-quarter expansion. Produces deck content; pair with demo-deck-writer if heavy product walkthroughs are needed.

entries.name: release-notes-writer
entries.description: Use for release notes — public-facing release notes, in-app changelog entries, customer-comms release summaries. Produces user-facing copy. For internal-only changelog entries use the same agent and ask for "internal" voice.

entries.name: sales-email-writer
entries.description: Use when the user needs a sales email, sales-email sequence, follow-up email, re-engagement email, or upsell/cross-sell email. Produces ready-to-send copy, not strategy.

entries.name: sales-leader-advisor
entries.description: Use when the user wants to think through a sales-leadership decision — comp plans, hiring, segmentation, territory design, forecast reviews, deal escalation, sales process changes. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: sdr-cadence-builder
entries.description: Use for outbound prospecting cadences — multi-touch, multi-channel sequences (email + LinkedIn + call + video) for SDRs. Produces full sequences with timing and triggers. Pair with cold-outreach-copywriter for individual messages.

entries.name: seo-meta-writer
entries.description: Use for SEO and social meta — title tags, meta descriptions, H1, OG/Twitter cards, schema-markup snippets, and slug suggestions. Use after content is drafted, not before.

entries.name: social-post-writer
entries.description: Use for organic social posts — LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram captions, Threads, Bluesky. Produces platform-tuned posts, not paid-ad copy (use ad-copywriter for paid).

entries.name: speaker-bio-writer
entries.description: Use for speaker bios, panel intros, podcast guest intros, conference profile copy, "About the author" blurbs. Produces multiple length variants. Short-form, voice-of-the-introducer.

entries.name: strategy-coach
entries.description: Use for strategic thinking — playing-to-win exercises, where-to-play / how-to-win decisions, market-entry strategy, portfolio strategy, M&A target evaluation, "should we even do this?" questions. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: talent-strategist
entries.description: Use for talent strategy — hiring plans, sourcing strategy, recruiter capacity, hiring funnel diagnostics, exec search strategy, employer brand. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: user-story-writer
entries.description: Use for user stories and acceptance criteria — for sprint planning, ticket grooming, feature breakdown. Produces well-formed stories with acceptance criteria. For full PRDs use prd-writer.

entries.name: variance-explainer-writer
entries.description: Use for variance writeups — explaining plan-vs-actual variances, period-over-period swings, MoM/QoQ unusual movements. Produces the explanatory narrative finance teams send to leadership and audit. Concise and surgical.

entries.name: video-script-writer
entries.description: Use for video scripts — YouTube long-form, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, sales videos, explainer videos, AI-generated video prompts (Sora, Veo, Runway). Produces a script with shot-level direction.

entries.name: vision-memo-writer
entries.description: Use for vision memos, strategy memos, mission/vision documents, and "where we're going" narrative pieces written for company-wide or board audiences. Produces the memo, not the strategy itself (use ceo-advisor for the underlying thinking).
